name: CivicDataForge
tagline: Official government records for agents, with source links
description: Government evidence for agents: US short-term-rental permits, property violations, HHS-OIG exclusions, EPA ECHO and the Norwegian company register, each result with source links. Tool discovery works without a key; record lookups run on your own Apify token (sent as the X-Apify-Token header) and are billed to your Apify account.
